d: Chris talks about being a big country fan, getting tested by Garth Brooks, lying to Jimmy Buffett, his family being very strict about holiday decorations, his father-in-law Arnold Schwarzenegger FaceTiming his grandchildren when he was dressed as Santa, the crazy gift Arnold got them, his new movie Way of the Warrior Kid, seeing Gremlins and Nightmare on Elm Street when he was a kid, being named King of Comedy at the Nickelodeon Kids’ Choice Awards and getting very slimed.
